text:
GENERATE BURST L9-sky-1_0 — Run C-9 P5 parallax panel by OUTPAINTING (Matt R-C9-13). task_id "L9-sky-1_0".

This image is one panel (the RIGHT half) of a 2x1 grid of 1536x1024 panels (neighbours overlap by 256 px) that together form ONE continuous painted parallax background layer for a 2D game scene seen past a cliff edge. The whole layer is the MANUSCRIPT SKY layer, the farthest backdrop: a sky painted as a Book of Hours paints it — deep LAPIS BLUE at the top, lightening through softer blue to a band of PALE GOLD and cream at the horizon near the bottom (evening light, NOT a dramatic sunset: no orange blaze, no sun disc, no rays); a few small stylised clouds drawn with a pen line and a soft uneven wash; a scatter of tiny gold stars in the upper blue. NO land at all.
IMAGE 1 is the canvas to EDIT: its LEFT 256 columns are ALREADY PAINTED (real pixels from neighbouring panels); the rest is flat mid-grey placeholder. Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 image: keep the painted strips as they are and replace the placeholder with painting that CONTINUES them seamlessly (no visible join), following the layer description for this panel's position.
STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above; line, hatching and washes matched to IMAGE 2 (the approved painted style of this level), the pen line lighter and thinner with distance. IMAGE 3 is a manuscript page: take from it how a Book of Hours paints this kind of subject (palette, simplification, the way distance is painted); not its layout, figures or text. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if a painted strip was altered, a join remains, the layer contains a cliff rim/characters/text, or (keyed layers) the area above the silhouette is not flat pure #00ff00 — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/L9-sky-1_0.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L9-sky-1_0"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the canvas to EDIT (painted neighbour strips + placeholder)
IMAGE 2 — the approved painted STYLE of this level (line, hatching, washes; not its layout)
IMAGE 3 — manuscript page: how this subject is painted (not its layout, figures or text)
